title: DJ CringleMod
description: This adds two new music discs which can be crafted from a new end ore! This also adds a new painting! The discs can be traded for from a butcher.
body:
This mod adds a few small but really fun additions to Minecraft, mainly focused around music, collecting, and exploration in The End. It introduces custom music discs with original tracks by the artist DJ Cringlebop that can either be crafted or earned through villager trading. One way to get them is by trading with a Butcher villager, giving the profession another useful purpose outside of food trades. The other method involves mining a brand new ore that naturally generates throughout The End dimension. Along with the music discs, the mod also adds a custom painting that can be used to decorate bases, houses, or other builds. It fits well into both survival and creative worlds and adds a little more personality to interiors.

DJ Cringlebop: https://open.spotify.com/artist/0d68HnWOBEX9d6PKemqF28
